[[Simona Berman]] (daughter; [[SM090]]) |java=[[Noriko Hidaka]] (mother) }} The '''mother and daughter''' (Japanese: '''いつもの{{tt|親子|しんし}}''' ''usual mother and daughter'') are two minor characters who first appeared in the prologue of ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]''. Since then, they have made cameo appearances in many [[Pokémon movie]]s. ==History== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== In ''[[M08|Lucario and the Mystery of Mew]]'', the mother was reading the history of [[Rota]] to her daughter. The little girl insisted that her mother read the story again, which her mother accepted. In ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', they were seen traveling through [[Alamos Town]] when they were buying cotton candy from a man at a stand. They were seen again when {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}} attacked several Pokémon in the town square. In ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'', they were seen walking in a town while [[Zero]] attacked {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} with his {{p|Magnemite}}, {{p|Magneton}}, and {{p|Magnezone}}. They were seen walking past Ash and his friends during the ending credits for ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''. In ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'', they were seen walking along the sidewalk behind [[Peg]]. In [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']], they were passed by Ash, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} during the battle tournament in [[Eindoak Town]]. They later witnessed the [[Sword of the Vale]] being lifted into the air. ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]], they'' appeared when Ash and his friends got off the train in [[Windy Station]] and they were seen again in the end credits where Ash, Iris, and Cilan are seen eating ice cream on a bridge. In the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]'', they were among the guests taking a tour of [[Pokémon Hills]] with [[Eric]]. Their hairstyles and outfit structure are very similar to that in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. The Sword of Justice]]'', but the colors of the outfits are completely changed. They made another appearance during the {{me|Latias}} and Mega {{p|Latios}} journal in the Japanese version of [[XY050]], where they were seen riding a plane. This segment was later dubbed as part of the [[Mega Evolution Pokédex Short]]s. This marked their first appearance in the main series. In ''[[M18|Hoopa and the Clash of Ages]]'', they could be seen when they were evacuated from the space-time collapse via one of {{an|Hoopa}}'s rings. Their hairstyles match the traditional designs, but their outfits are completely different, both structurally and color-wise. The pair appeared in ''[[SM090|Securing the Future!]]'', among a crowd watching [[Hala]] on [[television]]. Their hair colors are noticeably different: black instead of brown hair for the mother, and brown instead of orange hair for the daughter. The daughter's shirt, while similar in structure in other appearances, is colored pink-over-white rather than yellow-over-pink. ===''I Choose You!'' trilogy=== In ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a different continuity from {{aniseries|PTS}}, they were seen walking through an unknown town. Later at the end of the film, they were seen sitting in garden together with a {{p|Poochyena}}. In ''[[M21|The Power of Us]]'', they were seen by the veranda with a {{p|Bayleef}} watching lanterns in the sky. In ''[[M23|Secrets of the Jungle]]'', they were seen walking around [[Milyfa Town]]. ===Other appearances=== In ''[[M22|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution]]'', they were seen during the ending credits. In ''[[A Ripple in Time]]'', they were seen passing {{an|Cynthia}} and her {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}}. ===Gallery=== File:Mother and daughter M10.png|Cameo appearance in ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'' File:Mother and daughter M11.png|Cameo appearance in ''[[M11|Giratina and the Sky Warrior]]'' File:Mother and daughter M12.png|Cameo appearance in ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'' File:Mother and daughter M13.png|Cameo appearance in ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]'' File:Mother and daughter M14.png|Cameo appearance in [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']] File:Mother and daughter M15.png|Cameo appearance in ''[[M15|Kyurem VS. In ''[[M19|Volcanion and the Mechanical Marvel]]'', a lookalike pair was seen walking through an unknown town. This pair uses the general color scheme of a teal outfit and brown hair for the mother, and a yellow outfit and orange hair for the daughter.
